unit.why: Three letters by R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov, copied from his manuscript, about a dispute over a shochet in Zhuravno (two to R. Simha of Bobrka, one in Yiddish to the leaseholders); they are documentary correspondence on a halakhic-communal controversy, recounting circumstances in passing but not telling a tale.
unit.boundary_note: division ends with the heading of the next section ('השמטות למערכת ז׳ זקיננו הרה"ק ר׳ יודא צבי מראזלא'), which belongs to the following division
